crossRefs.note: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly…
He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no…
For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure…

translations.web: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.
translations.bsb: so no one can say that you were baptized into my name.
translations.kjv: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.
translations.asv: lest any man should say that ye were baptized into my name.
